LOC_POLICY_AGOGE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +50% [ICON_Production] Production toward Ancient and Classical era melee, anti-cavalry, and ranged units.
LOC_POLICY_AGOGE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 生产远古和古典时代的近战、抗骑兵和远程单位时+50% [ICON_Production] 生产力。

LOC_POLICY_BASTIONS_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +6 City [ICON_Strength] Defense Strength. +5 City [ICON_Ranged] Ranged Strength.
LOC_POLICY_BASTIONS_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 城市 [ICON_Strength] 防御力+6。城市 [ICON_Ranged] 远程攻击力+5。

LOC_POLICY_CARAVANSARIES_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 所有 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币。

LOC_POLICY_CHARISMATIC_LEADER_DESCRIPTIO.en_US: +2 Influence points per turn toward earning city-state [ICON_Envoy] Envoys.
LOC_POLICY_CHARISMATIC_LEADER_DESCRIPTIO.zh_Hans_CN: 影响力点数每回合+2，以获得城邦 [ICON_Envoy] 使者。

LOC_POLICY_CHIVALRY_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +50% [ICON_Production] Production toward Industrial era and earlier heavy and light cavalry units.
LOC_POLICY_CHIVALRY_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 生产工业及更早时代的重型和轻型骑兵单位时+50% [ICON_Production] 生产力。

LOC_POLICY_COLLECTIVE_ACTIVISM_DESCRIPTI.en_US: +5% [ICON_Culture] Culture per city-state you are the Suzerain of.
LOC_POLICY_COLLECTIVE_ACTIVISM_DESCRIPTI.zh_Hans_CN: 作为宗主国时，每个下辖城邦将使您的 [ICON_Culture] 文化值+5%。

LOC_POLICY_COLONIAL_OFFICES_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +15% faster growth for cities not on your original [ICON_Capital] Capital's continent.
LOC_POLICY_COLONIAL_OFFICES_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 与您最初的 [ICON_Capital] 首都不在同一大陆的城市发展加速15%。

LOC_POLICY_COLONIAL_TAXES_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +25% [ICON_Gold] Gold in cities not on your original [ICON_Capital] Capital's continent.
LOC_POLICY_COLONIAL_TAXES_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 与您最初的 [ICON_Capital] 首都不在同一大陆的城市+25% [ICON_Gold] 金币。

LOC_POLICY_CONSCRIPTION_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Unit maintenance reduced by 1 [ICON_Gold] Gold per turn, per unit.
LOC_POLICY_CONSCRIPTION_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 每回合、每单位的单位维护费用减少1 [ICON_Gold] 金币。

LOC_POLICY_CONTAINMENT_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Each [ICON_Envoy] Envoy you send to a city-state counts as two, if its Suzerain has a different government than you.
LOC_POLICY_CONTAINMENT_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 如果城邦的宗主国和您的政体不同，您向城邦派遣的每个 [ICON_Envoy] 使者都被视为两个使者。

LOC_POLICY_CORVEE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +15% [ICON_Production] Production toward Ancient and Classical wonders.
LOC_POLICY_CORVEE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 为远古和古典奇观+15% [ICON_Production] 生产力。

LOC_POLICY_CRYPTOGRAPHY_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Enemy Spy level reduced by 2 in your lands. Your Spy level is increased by 1 for offensive operations.
LOC_POLICY_CRYPTOGRAPHY_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 在您的领土内，敌方间谍等级降低2级。您的间谍等级在出击行动时增加1级。

LOC_POLICY_DIPLOMATIC_LEAGUE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: The first [ICON_Envoy] Envoy you send to each city-state counts as two [ICON_Envoy] Envoys.
LOC_POLICY_DIPLOMATIC_LEAGUE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 您向每个城邦派遣的第一个 [ICON_Envoy] 使者会被视为2个 [ICON_Envoy] 使者。

LOC_POLICY_DISCIPLINE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +5 [ICON_Strength] Unit Combat Strength when fighting Barbarians.
LOC_POLICY_DISCIPLINE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 同蛮族战斗时，+5 [ICON_Strength] 单位战斗力。

LOC_POLICY_ECONOMIC_UNION_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +100% Commercial Hub and Harbor district adjacency bonuses.

LOC_TECH_MINING_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 允许砍伐树林和开采 [ICON_RESOURCE_Copper] 铜。

LOC_TECH_POTTERY_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Allows harvesting of Bonus resources improved by Farms.
LOC_TECH_POTTERY_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 允许收获由农场改良的加成资源。

LOC_TECH_PRINTING_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Provides one more level of diplomatic visibility on all other civilizations. All [ICON_Tourism] Tourism yields from [ICON_GreatWork_Writing] Great Works of Writing are doubled.
LOC_TECH_PRINTING_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 为所有其他文明提供高于一个等级的外交能见度。从 [ICON_GreatWork_Writing] 著作巨作中获得的所有 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩收益翻倍。

LOC_TECH_REPLACEABLE_PARTS_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Upgrades Farm improvements to Mechanized Agriculture. +1 [ICON_Food] Food Adjacency bonus for every Farm improvement they are adjacent to.
LOC_TECH_REPLACEABLE_PARTS_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 升级农场改良设施为机械化农业。为邻近的每个农场改良设施+1 [ICON_Food] 食物相邻加成。

LOC_TECH_ROCKETRY_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 采石场改良设施+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力。

LOC_TECH_SANITATION_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 梯井改良设施+1 [ICON_Housing] 住房。

LOC_TECH_SCIENTIFIC_THEORY_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Allows Research Agreement diplomatic action. +1 [ICON_Food] Food from the Plantation improvement.
LOC_TECH_SCIENTIFIC_THEORY_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 允许外交行动研究协议。种植园改良设施+1 [ICON_Food] 食物。

LOC_TECH_SHIPBUILDING_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Allows all land units to embark.
LOC_TECH_SHIPBUILDING_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 允许所有陆地单位上船。

LOC_TECH_STEEL_DESCRIPTION.en_US: +1 [ICON_Production] Production from the Lumber Mill improvement. Unlocks Urban Defenses, giving all of your cities an automatic 400 Fortification Strength and the ability to perform a ranged attack. All previous wall improvements become obsolete and siege support units are no longer effective.
LOC_TECH_STEEL_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 从伐木场改良设施获得的 [ICON_Production] 生产力+1。解锁城市防御，为所有城市提供400点自动防御力和发起远程攻击的能力。之前的城墙改良设施将全部过时，攻城单位进攻时不再拥有特殊效果。

LOC_TECH_STIRRUPS_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 牧场改良设施提供的 [ICON_Food] 食物+1。

LOC_UNIT_AIRCRAFT_CARRIER_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Atomic era melee naval unit that can transport air units.
LOC_UNIT_AIRCRAFT_CARRIER_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 原子能时代的近战海军单位可运输空中单位。

LOC_UNIT_AMERICAN_P51_DESCRIPTION.en_US: American unique Atomic era air unit that replaces the Fighter.  Gains +5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength against fighter aircraft, has +2 flight range, and gains +50% experience.
LOC_UNIT_AMERICAN_P51_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 原子能时代的美国特色空中单位，取代战斗机。对阵战斗机时+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力、飞行范围+2、所获经验值+50%。

LOC_UNIT_ANTIAIR_GUN_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Atomic era anti-air support unit. Provides cover from air attacks up to 1 hex away from the weapon.
LOC_UNIT_ANTIAIR_GUN_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 原子能时代的防空支援单位。为一个格位以内的单位提供庇护以躲避空袭。

LOC_UNIT_APOSTLE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: May convert [ICON_Citizen] Citizens to their Religion and initiate theological combat with units of other Religions. Once per game may Launch Inquisition to allow the purchase of Inquisitors. Once per game may Evangelize Belief to add an additional Belief to their Religion. These uses consume the Apostle.
LOC_UNIT_APOSTLE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 能让 [ICON_Citizen] 公民皈依其所属的宗教，可对其他宗教的单位发动神学战争。每场游戏中可发起1次宗教审讯，购买审判官。每场游戏中可进行1次传道信仰，为其宗教额外增加1个信仰。这些行动均会消耗使徒的使用次数。

LOC_UNIT_ARABIAN_MAMLUK_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Arabian unique Medieval era unit that replaces the Knight. Heals at the end of every turn, even after moving or attacking.
LOC_UNIT_ARABIAN_MAMLUK_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 取代骑士的阿拉伯中世纪特色单位。在每回合结束时（甚至是在移动或攻击后），自动恢复生命值。

LOC_UNIT_ARCHAEOLOGIST_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Find and extract [ICON_GreatWork_Artifact] Artifacts from [ICON_RESOURCE_ANTIQUITY_SITE] Antiquity Sites to be displayed in their home city's Museum.
LOC_UNIT_ARCHAEOLOGIST_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 从 [ICON_RESOURCE_ANTIQUITY_SITE] 历史古迹发现和挖掘 [ICON_GreatWork_Artifact] 文物，并在其所属城市博物馆进行展出。

LOC_UNIT_ARCHER_DESCRIPTION.en_US: First Ancient era ranged unit with a [ICON_Range] Range of 2.
LOC_UNIT_ARCHER_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 第一个 [ICON_Range] 攻击范围是2的远古时代远程单位。

LOC_UNIT_ARTILLERY_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Modern era siege unit, ideal for attacking cities. Cannot move and attack on the same turn unless they've earned the Expert Crew promotion.
LOC_UNIT_ARTILLERY_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 现代攻城单位，适合对城市发起攻击。无法在一回合内移动并攻击（除非已获得“专家组”升级）。

LOC_UNIT_AT_CREW_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Modern era counter to cavalry class units.

LOC_UNIT_AZTEC_EAGLE_WARRIOR_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Aztec unique Ancient era unit that replaces the Warrior.  Has a chance to capture other civilization's military units by turning them into Builders.
LOC_UNIT_AZTEC_EAGLE_WARRIOR_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 取代勇士的阿兹特克远古时代特色单位。有几率把其他文明的军事单位转化为建造者并俘获。

LOC_UNIT_BARBARIAN_HORSEMAN_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 远古时代原始骑马勇士。

LOC_UNIT_BATTLESHIP_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Modern era naval ranged unit. Provides cover from air and nuclear attacks up to 1 tile away.
LOC_UNIT_BATTLESHIP_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 现代海军远程单位。为一个格位以内的单位提供庇护以躲避空袭和核攻击。

LOC_UNIT_BIPLANE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: First air combat unit, available in the Modern era.
LOC_UNIT_BIPLANE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 最早的空战单位，现代可用。

LOC_UNIT_BOMBARD_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Renaissance era siege unit, ideal for attacking cities. Cannot move and attack on the same turn unless they've earned the Expert Crew promotion.
LOC_UNIT_BOMBARD_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 文艺复兴时代攻城单位，适合对城市发起攻击。无法在一回合内移动并攻击（除非已获得“专家组”升级）。

LOC_UNIT_BOMBER_DESCRIPTION.en_US: First bomber unit, available in the Atomic era.
LOC_UNIT_BOMBER_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 最早的轰炸单位，原子能时代可用。

LOC_UNIT_BRAZILIAN_MINAS_GERAES_DESCRIPT.en_US: Brazilian unique Industrial era unit that replaces the Battleship. Stronger than the Battleship. Unlocked by Nationalism.
LOC_UNIT_BRAZILIAN_MINAS_GERAES_DESCRIPT.zh_Hans_CN: 工业时代的巴西特色单位，取代战舰，强于战舰。通过“民族主义”解锁。

LOC_UNIT_BUILDER_DESCRIPTION.en_US: May create tile improvements, remove features like Woods or Rainforest, or Harvest some resources. Builders can be used 3 times. This can be increased through policies or wonders like the Pyramids.
LOC_UNIT_BUILDER_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 可建造单元格改良设施、移除地貌（如森林或雨林），或收获资源。建造者可使用3次。可通过政策或奇观（如金字塔）增加使用次数。

LOC_UNIT_CARAVEL_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Fast Renaissance era exploration melee naval unit.
LOC_UNIT_CARAVEL_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 文艺复兴时期快速的探索近战海军单位。

LOC_UNIT_CATAPULT_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Classical era siege unit, ideal for attacking cities. Cannot move and attack on the same turn unless they've earned the Expert Crew promotion.
LOC_UNIT_CATAPULT_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 古典时代攻城单位，适合对城市发起攻击。无法在一回合内移动并攻击（除非已获得“专家组”升级）。

LOC_UNIT_CAVALRY_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Fast-moving Industrial era light cavalry unit.
LOC_UNIT_CAVALRY_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 能够快速移动的工业时代轻骑兵单位。

LOC_UNIT_CHINESE_CROUCHING_TIGER_DESCRIP.en_US: Chinese unique Medieval era unit. Ranged unit with a [ICON_Range] Range of 1 and high combat strength.
LOC_UNIT_CHINESE_CROUCHING_TIGER_DESCRIP.zh_Hans_CN: 中国中世纪特色单位。 [ICON_Range] 射程为1的高战斗力远程单位。

LOC_UNIT_DESTROYER_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Strongest melee naval unit. Reveals Naval Raiders within sight range.
LOC_UNIT_DESTROYER_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 最强大的近战海军单位。显示视线范围内的海军袭击者。

LOC_UNIT_ENGLISH_REDCOAT_DESCRIPTION.en_US: English unique Industrial era unit when Victoria is their leader that replaces the Line Infantry. +10 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when fighting on a continent other than that of your capital's. No disembark cost.
LOC_UNIT_ENGLISH_REDCOAT_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 维多利亚作为领袖时的工业时代英国特色单位，替代战列步兵。在非首都所处大陆作战时+10 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。下船不消耗移动力。

LOC_UNIT_ENGLISH_SEADOG_DESCRIPTION.en_US: English unique Renaissance era naval unit that replaces the Privateer. Has a chance to capture defeated enemy ships. Can only be seen by other Naval Raiders unless adjacent to it. Reveals Naval Raiders within sight range.
LOC_UNIT_ENGLISH_SEADOG_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 文艺复兴时代英国特色海军单位，取代私掠船。击败敌方船只后有几率将其俘获。除非与单位相邻，否则只能被其他海军袭击者发现。能使视线范围中的海军袭击者暴露位置。

LOC_UNIT_FIGHTER_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 原子能时代双翼机升级。

LOC_UNIT_FRENCH_GARDE_IMPERIALE_DESCRIPT.en_US: French unique Industrial era melee unit that replaces the Line Infantry. +10 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when fighting on your capital's continent. [ICON_GreatGeneral] Great General points for killing units.
LOC_UNIT_FRENCH_GARDE_IMPERIALE_DESCRIPT.zh_Hans_CN: 工业时代法国特色近战单位，替代战列步兵。在首都所处大陆作战时+10 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。击杀单位后将获得 [ICON_GreatGeneral] 大将军点数。

LOC_UNIT_FRIGATE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 文艺复兴时期的远程海军单位。

LOC_UNIT_GALLEY_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Ancient era melee naval combat unit. Can only operate on Coastal waters until Cartography is researched.
LOC_UNIT_GALLEY_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 远古时代近战海军战斗单位。在研究出制图学之前，只能用于沿海水域。

LOC_UNIT_GERMAN_UBOAT_DESCRIPTION.en_US: German unique Modern era naval unit that replaces the Submarine. Cheaper to produce, +1 Sight, and +10 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when fighting on Ocean tiles. Able to reveal other stealthed units.
LOC_UNIT_GERMAN_UBOAT_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 取代潜艇的德国特色现代海军单位。生产成本更低，+1视野，在海洋单元格作战时，+10 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。能发现其他隐形单位。

LOC_UNIT_GREAT_ADMIRAL_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Each [ICON_GreatAdmiral] Great Admiral has unique abilities, including a passive effect, and a Retire effect. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.
LOC_UNIT_GREAT_ADMIRAL_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 每个 [ICON_GreatAdmiral] 海军统帅都有特色能力，包括被动效果和隐退效果。访问伟人面板了解更多，并跟踪您的进度。

LOC_UNIT_GREAT_ARTIST_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Each [ICON_GreatArtist] Great Artist generates a [ICON_GreatWork_Landscape] Great Work of Art when activated. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.
LOC_UNIT_GREAT_ARTIST_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 激活时，每个 [ICON_GreatArtist] 大艺术家都能产生一个 [ICON_GreatWork_Landscape] 艺术巨作。访问伟人面板了解更多，并跟踪您的进度。

LOC_UNIT_GREAT_ENGINEER_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Each [ICON_GreatEngineer] Great Engineer has unique abilities when activated. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.
LOC_UNIT_GREAT_ENGINEER_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 激活时，每个 [ICON_GreatEngineer] 大工程师都会拥有特色能力。访问伟人面板了解更多，并跟踪您的进度。

LOC_UNIT_GREAT_GENERAL_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Each [ICON_GreatGeneral] Great General has unique abilities, including a passive effect, and a Retire effect. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.
LOC_UNIT_GREAT_GENERAL_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 每个 [ICON_GreatGeneral] 大将军都有特色能力，包括被动效果和隐退效果。访问伟人面板了解更多，并跟踪您的进度。

LOC_UNIT_GREAT_MERCHANT_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Each [ICON_GreatMerchant] Great Merchant has unique abilities when activated. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.
LOC_UNIT_GREAT_MERCHANT_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 激活时，每个 [ICON_GreatMerchant] 大商人都会拥有特色能力。访问伟人面板了解更多，并跟踪您的进度。

LOC_UNIT_GREAT_MUSICIAN_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Each [ICON_GreatMusician] Great Musician generates a [ICON_GreatWork_Music] Great Work of Music when activated. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.
LOC_UNIT_GREAT_MUSICIAN_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 激活时，每个 [ICON_GreatMusician] 大音乐家都能产生一个 [ICON_GreatWork_Music] 音乐巨作。访问伟人面板了解更多，并跟踪您的进度。

LOC_UNIT_GREAT_PROPHET_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Great [ICON_GreatProphet] Prophets can found a Religion when activated. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.
LOC_UNIT_GREAT_PROPHET_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 激活时，大 [ICON_GreatProphet] 预言家能创建一个宗教。访问伟人面板了解更多，并跟踪您的进度。

LOC_UNIT_GREAT_SCIENTIST_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Each [ICON_GreatScientist] Great Scientist has unique abilities when activated. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.
LOC_UNIT_GREAT_SCIENTIST_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 激活时，每个 [ICON_GreatScientist] 大科学家都会拥有特色能力。访问伟人面板了解更多，并跟踪您的进度。

LOC_UNIT_GREAT_WRITER_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Each [ICON_GreatWriter] Great Writer generates a [ICON_GreatWork_Writing] Great Work of Writing when activated. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.
LOC_UNIT_GREAT_WRITER_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 激活时，每个 [ICON_GreatWriter] 大作家都能产生一个 [ICON_GreatWork_Writing] 著作巨作。访问伟人面板了解更多，并跟踪您的进度。

LOC_UNIT_GREEK_HOPLITE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Greek unique Ancient era anti-cavalry unit that replaces the Spearman. +10 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength if there is at least one adjacent Hoplite unit.
LOC_UNIT_GREEK_HOPLITE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 远古时代希腊特色抗骑兵单位，替代枪兵。如与至少一个重装步兵相邻，则+10 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。

LOC_UNIT_GURU_DESCRIPTION.en_US: May use a charge to heal itself and all adjacent friendly religious units. May not initiate theological combat with units of other Religions (but can defend).
LOC_UNIT_GURU_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 消耗次数可治疗其自身以及相邻的全部友方宗教单位。无法发起和其他宗教单位的神学战争（但可进行防御）。

LOC_UNIT_HEAVY_CHARIOT_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Hard-hitting, Ancient era heavy cavalry unit. Gains 1 bonus [ICON_Movement] Movement if it begins a turn on a flat tile with no Woods, Rainforest, or Hills.
LOC_UNIT_HEAVY_CHARIOT_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 远古时代重骑兵单位，威力惊人。如果在一个没有树林、雨林和丘陵的平坦单元格上开始一个回合，会获得1 [ICON_Movement] 移动力加成。

LOC_UNIT_HELICOPTER_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Fast-moving Atomic era light cavalry unit.
LOC_UNIT_HELICOPTER_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 移动迅速的原子能时代轻骑兵单位。

LOC_UNIT_HORSEMAN_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Fast-moving Classical era light cavalry unit.
LOC_UNIT_HORSEMAN_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 移动迅速的古典时代轻骑兵单位。

LOC_UNIT_INDIAN_VARU_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Indian unique Classical era heavy cavalry unit.  Adjacent enemy units receive -5 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength.
LOC_UNIT_INDIAN_VARU_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 古典时代的印度特色单位。与其相邻的敌方单位 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力-5。

LOC_UNIT_IRONCLAD_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Powerful Industrial era armored melee naval unit.
LOC_UNIT_IRONCLAD_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 强大的工业时代装甲近战海军单位。

LOC_UNIT_JAPANESE_SAMURAI_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Japanese unique Medieval era melee unit that replaces the Man-At-Arms. Does not suffer combat penalties when damaged.
LOC_UNIT_JAPANESE_SAMURAI_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 中世纪日本特色近战单位，替代披甲战士。受伤后不会蒙受战斗力减益。

LOC_UNIT_KNIGHT_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Hard-hitting, Medieval era heavy cavalry unit.
LOC_UNIT_KNIGHT_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 中世纪重骑兵单位，威力惊人。

LOC_UNIT_KONGO_SHIELD_BEARER_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Kongo unique Classical era unit that replaces the Swordsman. +10 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when defending against ranged attacks. Can move and see through Woods and Rainforest.
LOC_UNIT_KONGO_SHIELD_BEARER_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 取代剑客的刚果古典时代特色单位。防御远程攻击时+10 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。能穿行以及视野能穿过树林和雨林。

LOC_UNIT_MEDIC_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Industrial era support unit. Can heal adjacent units.
LOC_UNIT_MEDIC_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 工业时代支援单位。能治疗邻近单位。

LOC_UNIT_MISSILE_CRUISER_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Strongest ranged naval unit, available in the Information era.
LOC_UNIT_MISSILE_CRUISER_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 最强大的远程海军单位，信息时代可用。

LOC_UNIT_MISSIONARY_DESCRIPTION.en_US: May convert [ICON_Citizen] Citizens to their Religion. May not initiate theological combat with units of other Religions (but can defend).
LOC_UNIT_MISSIONARY_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 能让 [ICON_Citizen] 公民皈依所属宗教。无法对其他宗教单位发动神学战争（但可以进行防御）。

LOC_UNIT_MOBILE_SAM_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Information era anti-air support unit. Provides cover from air and nuclear attacks up to 1 hex away from the weapon.
LOC_UNIT_MOBILE_SAM_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 信息时代的防空支援单位。为一个格位以内的单位提供庇护以躲避空袭和核攻击。

LOC_UNIT_MODERN_ARMOR_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Information era heavy cavalry unit that is fast and strong.
LOC_UNIT_MODERN_ARMOR_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 又快又强大的信息时代重骑兵单位。

LOC_UNIT_MODERN_AT_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Information era counter to cavalry class units.
LOC_UNIT_MODERN_AT_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 信息时代的抗骑兵类单位。

LOC_UNIT_MUSKETMAN_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 文艺复兴时期近战单位。

LOC_UNIT_NATURALIST_DESCRIPTION.en_US: A late-game civilian who can create a single National Park to attract [ICON_Tourism] Tourists. Must be purchased with [ICON_Faith] Faith.
LOC_UNIT_NATURALIST_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 游戏后期平民单位，可以创建一座国家公园来吸引 [ICON_Tourism] 游客。 只能使用 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值购买。

LOC_UNIT_NORWEGIAN_BERSERKER_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Norwegian unique Medieval era melee unit that replaces the Man-At-Arms. 4 [ICON_Movement] Movement if this unit starts in enemy territory. +10 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when attacking and -5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when defending against melee attacks.
LOC_UNIT_NORWEGIAN_BERSERKER_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 中世纪挪威特色近战单位，替代披甲战士。若该单位从敌方领土开始回合，则拥有4点 [ICON_Movement] 移动力。进攻时+10 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力，防御近战攻击时-5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。

LOC_UNIT_NORWEGIAN_LONGSHIP_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Norwegian unique Ancient era naval unit that replaces the Galley. Can pillage enemy coastal lands and capture civilians if adjacent using its coastal raiding ability. 4 [ICON_Movement] Movement while in coastal waters.
LOC_UNIT_NORWEGIAN_LONGSHIP_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 取代桨帆船的挪威远古时代特色海军单位。通过海岸扫荡能力，可掠夺敌方海岸土地，并俘获附近的平民。能在中立领土上恢复。位于海岸水域时， [ICON_Movement] 移动力为4。

LOC_UNIT_NUCLEAR_SUBMARINE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Highly advanced Information era ranged raiding naval unit that can be armed with nuclear weapons. Can only be seen by other Naval Raiders unless adjacent to it. Reveals Naval Raiders within sight range.
LOC_UNIT_NUCLEAR_SUBMARINE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 高度发达的信息时代海军远程袭击单位，能配备核武器。除非与单位相邻，否则只能被其他海军袭击者发现。能使视线范围中的海军袭击者暴露位置。

LOC_UNIT_OBSERVATION_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Modern era support unit. Grants +1 [ICON_Range] Range to Siege class units within 1 hex.
LOC_UNIT_OBSERVATION_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 现代支援单位。为1单元格内的攻城类单位+1 [ICON_Range] 射程。

LOC_UNIT_PRIVATEER_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Renaissance era ranged naval unit with the ability to coastal raid.Can only be seen by other Naval Raiders unless adjacent to it. Reveals Naval Raiders within sight range.
LOC_UNIT_PRIVATEER_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 文艺复兴时期的远程海军单位，能够进行海岸扫荡。除非与单位相邻，否则只能被其他海军袭击者发现。能使视线范围中的海军袭击者暴露位置。

LOC_UNIT_QUADRIREME_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Classical era ranged naval unit. Can only operate on Coastal waters until Cartography is researched.
LOC_UNIT_QUADRIREME_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 古典时期远程海军单位。在研究出制图学之前，只能用于沿海水域。

LOC_UNIT_RANGER_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 能够快速移动的工业时代侦察单位。

LOC_UNIT_ROCKET_ARTILLERY_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Information era siege unit, ideal for attacking cities. Cannot move and attack on the same turn unless they've earned the Expert Crew promotion.
LOC_UNIT_ROCKET_ARTILLERY_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 信息时代攻城单位，适合对城市发起攻击。无法在一回合内移动并攻击（除非已获得“专家组”升级）。

LOC_UNIT_ROMAN_LEGION_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Roman unique Classical era melee unit that replaces the Swordsman. Can build a Roman Fort.
LOC_UNIT_ROMAN_LEGION_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 取代剑客的罗马古典时代特色近战单位。能建造一个罗马堡垒。

LOC_UNIT_RUSSIAN_COSSACK_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Russian unique Industrial era unit that replaces Cavalry. Stronger than Cavalry, and gains +5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when fighting in or adjacent to its home territory. Can move after attacking if [ICON_Movement] Movement points remain.
LOC_UNIT_RUSSIAN_COSSACK_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 取代骑兵的俄罗斯工业时代特色单位。比骑兵更强大，位于或靠近俄罗斯领土作战时，+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。如有剩余 [ICON_Movement] 移动力，可在攻击后移动。

LOC_UNIT_SCOUT_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 能够快速移动的远古时代侦察单位。

LOC_UNIT_SCYTHIAN_HORSE_ARCHER_DESCRIPTI.en_US: Scythian unique Classical era unit. Ranged unit with 4 [ICON_Movement] Movement with a [ICON_Range] Range of 1.
LOC_UNIT_SCYTHIAN_HORSE_ARCHER_DESCRIPTI.zh_Hans_CN: 斯基泰古典时代特色单位。是 [ICON_Range] 射程为1， [ICON_Movement] 移动力为4的远程单位。

LOC_UNIT_SETTLER_DESCRIPTION.en_US: May create new cities. Reduces city's [ICON_Citizen] Population by 1 when completed.
LOC_UNIT_SETTLER_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 可创建新城市。完成时，该城市 [ICON_Citizen] 人口减1。

LOC_UNIT_SLINGER_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Weak Ancient era ranged unit. Better on attack than defense.
LOC_UNIT_SLINGER_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 薄弱的远古时代远程单位。攻强守弱。

LOC_UNIT_SPANISH_CONQUISTADOR_DESCRIPTIO.en_US: Spanish unique Renaissance era unit that replaces the Musketman. +10 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when there is a religious unit within one hex. If this unit captures a city or is adjacent to a city when it is captured, the city will automatically adopt the Conquistador player's Religion as the dominant Religion.
LOC_UNIT_SPANISH_CONQUISTADOR_DESCRIPTIO.zh_Hans_CN: 文艺复兴时期西班牙特色单位，替代火枪手。与宗教单位处于同一单元格中时，+10 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。如果此单位占领城市、或在城市被占领时处于相邻单元格中，该城市会自动将该单位所属玩家的宗教采纳为主流宗教。

LOC_UNIT_SPY_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Performs secret missions in foreign cities and protects your cities from enemy Spies.
LOC_UNIT_SPY_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 可在国外城市执行秘密任务，或保护您的城市免遭敌方间谍骚扰。

LOC_UNIT_SUBMARINE_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Modern era ranged raiding naval unit. Can only be seen by other Naval Raiders unless adjacent to it. Reveals Naval Raiders within sight range.
LOC_UNIT_SUBMARINE_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 现代海军远程袭击单位。除非与单位相邻，否则只能被其他海军袭击者发现。能使视线范围中的海军袭击者暴露位置。

LOC_UNIT_SUMERIAN_WAR_CART_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Sumerian unique Ancient era unit. Stronger than all other starting units. No penalties against anti-cavalry units. 4 [ICON_Movement] Movement if this unit starts in open terrain.
LOC_UNIT_SUMERIAN_WAR_CART_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 苏美尔远古时代特色单位。比其他所有初始单位更强大。对战抗骑兵单位时，无减益。如果该单位从开阔地形开始回合， [ICON_Movement] 移动力为4。

LOC_UNIT_SWORDSMAN_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 强大的古典时代近战单位。

LOC_UNIT_TANK_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Fast-moving Modern era heavy cavalry unit that ignores zone of control.
LOC_UNIT_TANK_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 能够快速移动的现代重骑兵单位，它能忽略控制区。

LOC_UNIT_TRADER_DESCRIPTION.en_US: May make and maintain a single [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route. Automatically creates Roads as it travels.
LOC_UNIT_TRADER_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 能创建和维护一条 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线。随着旅途进行，自动创建道路。

LOC_UNIT_TREBUCHET_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Medieval era siege unit, ideal for attacking cities. Cannot move and attack on the same turn unless they've earned the Expert Crew promotion.
LOC_UNIT_TREBUCHET_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 中世纪攻城单位，适合对城市发起攻击。无法在一回合内移动并攻击（除非已获得“专家组”升级）。

LOC_UNIT_WARRIOR_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 薄弱的远古时代近战单位。

LOC_UNIT_WARRIOR_MONK_DESCRIPTION.en_US: Fast-moving land combat unit with a unique promotion tree.
LOC_UNIT_WARRIOR_MONK_DESCRIPTION.zh_Hans_CN: 高移动力的陆地战斗单位，拥有独特的升级树。

LOC_VICTORY_CULTURE_TEXT.en_US: The worth of a culture is not measured by its accomplishments, but in how those accomplishments last, and how they are remembered. The beauty that you have inspired our people to create will ensure that our culture stands for all time.
LOC_VICTORY_CULTURE_TEXT.zh_Hans_CN: 文化的价值不是由它的成就来衡量，而是如何将这些成就延续下去，以及如何让它们被后人记住。您所描绘的美好蓝图激励了我们的人民开拓进取…也将确保我们的文明万古长青。

LOC_VICTORY_DEFAULT_TEXT.en_US: Everyone else has lost... Therefore you've won!
LOC_VICTORY_DEFAULT_TEXT.zh_Hans_CN: 其他人都失败了…所以，您赢啦！

LOC_VICTORY_DOMINATION_TEXT.en_US: Though its face may change throughout the ages, history is written from the hand of the victor. By your actions this day, you ensure our people are glorious tomorrow.
LOC_VICTORY_DOMINATION_TEXT.zh_Hans_CN: 尽管历史的变迁会改变它的容颜，但历史是由胜者的双手所著。以您今日所为，您必将带领人民走向辉煌的明天。

LOC_VICTORY_RELIGION_TEXT.en_US: We have a basic need to believe in something greater than ourselves. We crave solace in the darkness, a light unto our path. Thanks to you, we’ve found meaning amid the Cosmos.
LOC_VICTORY_RELIGION_TEXT.zh_Hans_CN: 我们的一个基本需求是相信比自己更伟大的事物。在黑暗中，我们渴望慰藉，渴望灯光照亮我们的道路。谢谢您，我们已在宇宙中找到了意义。

LOC_VICTORY_SCIENCE_TEXT.en_US: Much as our ancestors did ages ago, we thrust forward into the unknown. The first pioneers set forth on an uneasy course, and yet once again our people thrive.
LOC_VICTORY_SCIENCE_TEXT.zh_Hans_CN: 正如祖先在很多年前所做的那样，我们渴望了解未知世界。先驱已踏上艰险的旅程，我们的国民再一次茁壮成长。

LOC_VICTORY_SCORE_TEXT.en_US: From our humble beginnings ages ago have you forged a civilization that has withstood time itself. Though countless civilizations rise and fall around us, we do not just survive. We prosper.
LOC_VICTORY_SCORE_TEXT.zh_Hans_CN: 从多年前的渺小开始，您铸造的文明经受住了时间考验。虽然无数文明在我们眼前兴起、衰落，但我们幸存了下来。我们成功了。

LOC_VIZSOURCE_ACTION_ALLY.zh_Hans_CN: 成为盟友（研究行政部门）。

LOC_VIZSOURCE_ACTION_DELEGATE.en_US: Send a delegation or establish an embassy.
LOC_VIZSOURCE_ACTION_DELEGATE.zh_Hans_CN: 派遣代表团或建立大使馆。

LOC_VIZSOURCE_ACTION_GREAT_PERSON_JOURNA.en_US: Use Mary Katherine Goddard's Great Merchant ability.
LOC_VIZSOURCE_ACTION_GREAT_PERSON_JOURNA.zh_Hans_CN: 使用玛丽·凯瑟琳·戈达德的大商人能力。

LOC_VIZSOURCE_ACTION_SPY.en_US: Send a Spy on a Listening Post mission.
LOC_VIZSOURCE_ACTION_SPY.zh_Hans_CN: 派遣一名间谍执行情报站的任务。

LOC_VIZSOURCE_GREAT_PERSON_JOURNALISM.en_US: Mary Katherine Goddard's Great Merchant effect
LOC_VIZSOURCE_GREAT_PERSON_JOURNALISM.zh_Hans_CN: 玛丽·凯瑟琳·戈达德的大商人影响力
